findings.text: The confirmation statement is overdue; it was next due 13 September 2026 and was last made up to 30 August 2025.
Accounts are not overdue; they were last made up to 31 December 2025 and the next accounts are due 30 September 2027.
Companies House holds no insolvency record for this company.
The company has 10 current officers, including 9 directors, and one other officer.
One current person with significant control is recorded: CORPORATE CONTROLLER 2676, a company holding 75 to 100 percent of shares and voting rights.
Of 5 current directors checked, 49 other companies were found: 36 active, 11 dissolved and 2 in liquidation, so directors are linked to two companies in insolvency processes.
The company has 11 satisfied charges registered and no outstanding or part-satisfied charges.
Since 24 October 2025, one officer appointment was filed (PERSON 644 as director, 9 July 2026) and no resignations; no registered office address changes were filed.

headline.text: TEST COMPANY 689 is an active company incorporated on 6 December 2013, with its confirmation statement overdue and no insolvency record held at Companies House.
